opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research infrastructure, including research libraries and public engagement with science.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts). 2026 round is closed; next round details expected in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing listed historic sites (Grade I/II*/Scheduled Monument etc.); UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working with disability (with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable); UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment to help people live more independently, with focus on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working in mental health (with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable); UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment, with emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities providing care and services for older people (with at least a 'Good' CQC rating where applicable); UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS (with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable); UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating accredited libraries/archives caring for nationally significant collections; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating accredited museums/galleries with nationally significant collections; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, including refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, including building/refurbishment and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for projects improving public engagement with science through the history of science, including refurbishing/creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority running special schools/colleges for children and young people with special educational needs; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for projects supporting secondary-level pupils with special educational needs to develop skills for employment or independent living after school or college.
